concerns.text: The plan cites the DSRT (Domain‑Specific Risk‑Taking) scores dataset via the Hugging Face URL `https://huggingface.co/datasets/dsrtrain/augmath_prompt/...`. This dataset appears to contain augmented math prompts rather than validated risk‑taking behavioral scores. Using it as the outcome variable for real‑world decision risk‑taking is therefore inappropriate and constitutes a wrong‑dataset choice for the research question.
